what.zh: 运放的差分输入级：两个晶体管怎么分一股电流，为什么只对 v₊ − v₋ 敏感。
what.en: The op-amp's differential input stage: how two transistors share one current, and why only v₊ − v₋ matters.

back.zh: 运放最前面的差分输入级就是一个差分对。
back.en: The op-amp's first stage, the differential input, is a differential pair.

what.zh: 高增益级其实是一个共射放大器：增益从哪来。
what.en: The high-gain stage is a common-emitter amplifier: where the gain comes from.

back.zh: 运放中间的高增益级就是一个共射放大器。
back.en: The op-amp's middle, high-gain stage is a common-emitter amplifier.

what.zh: 推挽输出级：交越失真从哪来，输出为什么到不了电源轨。
what.en: The push-pull output stage: where crossover distortion comes from, and why the output can't reach the rails.

back.zh: 运放的输出级就是一个推挽放大器，LM358 到不了正电源轨的原因在这里。
back.en: The op-amp's output stage is a push-pull amplifier; this is why the LM358 can't reach its positive rail.

what.zh: 补偿电容：为什么频率越高，运放的增益越低。
what.en: The compensation capacitor: why an op-amp's gain falls as frequency rises.

back.zh: 运放里的补偿电容决定了增益带宽积。
back.en: The compensation capacitor inside the op-amp sets the gain-bandwidth product.

what.zh: 压摆率和失调：现象、原因、怎么测。
what.en: Slew rate and offset: what you see, why, and how to measure them.

back.zh: LM358 的实际限制（压摆率、失调）在这里展开。
back.en: The LM358's real limits (slew rate, offset) are worked out here.

what.zh: 频率一高，开环增益 A 就变小，虚短不再成立：用增益带宽积算它在哪里失效。
what.en: At high frequency the open-loop gain A drops and the virtual short fails: the gain-bandwidth product tells you where.

back.zh: 虚短要求 A 足够大；这里讲 A 随频率下降时会怎样。
back.en: The virtual short needs a large A; this is what happens when A falls with frequency.

what.zh: 把反相放大器的 R_f 换成电容，就得到积分器：方波进，三角波出（Sadiku §6.6）。
what.en: Replace R_f of the inverting amplifier with a capacitor and you get an integrator: square wave in, triangle out (Sadiku §6.6).

back.zh: 这就是反相放大器把 R_f 换成电容的样子。
back.en: This is the inverting amplifier with R_f replaced by a capacitor.

what.zh: R_f 换成 R 并 C 的阻抗 Z_f，增益 −Z_f/Z_in 随频率变：有源低通。
what.en: Replace R_f with the impedance Z_f of R parallel C; the gain −Z_f/Z_in changes with frequency: an active low-pass.

back.zh: 反相放大器的 −R_f/R_in 推广成 −Z_f/Z_in，就是这个滤波器。
back.en: Generalise the inverting amplifier's −R_f/R_in to −Z_f/Z_in and you get this filter.

what.zh: 两级 RC 滤波器中间加一个跟随器，级与级不再互相拖累。
what.en: A follower between two RC filter stages stops them from loading each other.

back.zh: 这里的跟随器就是 World 3 的 5c，用来隔离两级滤波器。
back.en: The follower here is World 3's unit 5c, isolating the two filter stages.

what.zh: 给比较器加一点正反馈，得到两个阈值：施密特触发器。
what.en: Add a little positive feedback to a comparator and get two thresholds: the Schmitt trigger.

back.zh: 施密特触发器就是加了正反馈的比较器。
back.en: A Schmitt trigger is a comparator with positive feedback.

what.zh: 比较器的输出只有“高”和“低”：从这里走进 0 和 1 的数字世界。
what.en: A comparator's output is only high or low: from here into the digital world of 0 and 1.

back.zh: 比较器把模拟电压变成高 / 低两种状态，这就是数字逻辑的起点。
back.en: A comparator turns an analog voltage into high / low; that is where digital logic starts.

what.zh: 运放的电路模型就是一个电压控制电压源（VCVS）：在结点法里怎么处理它。
what.en: The op-amp's circuit model is a voltage-controlled voltage source (VCVS): how nodal analysis handles one.

back.zh: 这道题里的 VCVS 就是运放“黑盒子”模型的样子。
back.en: The VCVS in this problem is what the op-amp's black-box model looks like.

what.zh: 结点法、网孔法原样搬到交流电路：把 R 换成复数阻抗 Z（ET-140 Week 10）。
what.en: Nodal and mesh analysis carried over to AC: replace R with a complex impedance Z (ET-140 Week 10).

back.zh: 这些题就是 World 2 的结点法、网孔法，只是 R 换成了 Z。
back.en: These are World 2's nodal and mesh problems with R replaced by Z.

what.zh: 叠加、戴维宁原样搬到交流电路：把 R 换成复数阻抗 Z（ET-140 Week 10）。
what.en: Superposition and Thévenin carried over to AC: replace R with a complex impedance Z (ET-140 Week 10).

back.zh: 这些题就是 World 2 的叠加、戴维宁，只是 R 换成了 Z。
back.en: These are World 2's superposition and Thévenin problems with R replaced by Z.

what.zh: 同一个 RC：在时域看充放电，在频域看低通。τ = RC 和 f_c = 1/(2πRC) 是同一件事。
what.en: The same RC: charging in the time domain, a low-pass in the frequency domain. τ = RC and f_c = 1/(2πRC) are the same fact.

back.zh: 这个低通滤波器就是 World 4 充放电实验里的那个 RC。
back.en: This low-pass filter is the same RC as in World 4's charging lab.

what.zh: 把三个频率点连成波特图：分贝、对数频率轴、渐近线（ET-220 Week 7–8）。
what.en: Turn three frequency points into a Bode plot: decibels, a log frequency axis, asymptotes (ET-220 Week 7–8).

back.zh: World 5 的 RC 低通是波特图的第一个例子。
back.en: World 5's RC low-pass is the first Bode-plot example.

what.zh: 晶体管开关就是一个反相器：输入高，输出低。
what.en: A transistor switch is an inverter: input high, output low.

back.zh: NOT 门最简单的做法就是 World 6 的三极管开关。
back.en: The simplest NOT gate is World 6's transistor switch.

what.zh: 共射放大器的增益在低频和高频为什么会掉（ET-220 Week 11）。
what.en: Why a common-emitter amplifier loses gain at low and high frequencies (ET-220 Week 11).

back.zh: 这里分析的就是 World 6 的共射放大器。
back.en: This is World 6's common-emitter amplifier, analysed over frequency.

what.zh: 用 555 给数字电路做时钟（ET-220 Week 4 / ET-540 Lab 9）。
what.en: A 555 as the clock of a digital circuit (ET-220 Week 4 / ET-540 Lab 9).

back.zh: 这个时钟就是 World 7 的 555 振荡器。
